# Signalsmith Stretch

Vendored unmodified headers from release `1.0.0`, commit
`4cbaafc2da4fce3b5cbbff74c8afdb07dc43d790`:
https://github.com/Signalsmith-Audio/signalsmith-stretch

The MIT licenses for Stretch and its bundled DSP library are included.
MuseTone uses the default quality preset with stereo-linked processing,
fixed-duration rendering, latency compensation, and blockwise cancellation.
